debug.description: Debug level [0..3]. Higher values produce more verbose logs.

map_request_retries.description: Additional Map-Requests to send per map cache miss.

log_file.description: Log file path when running in daemon mode.

operating_mode.description: LISP device operating mode: 'xTR', 'RTR', 'MN', or 'MS'. Enum: xTR, RTR, MN, MS

control_iface.description: Interface for control messages (MS mode). Required for MS operating mode.

ms_eid_prefix.description: Accepted EID prefix for Map Server registration (MS mode). e.g., '10.0.0.0/24'.

ms_key.description: Password to authenticate Map-Registers received by the Map Server (MS mode).

ms_accept_more_specifics.description: Accept more specific prefixes with same authentication information for MS lisp-site.

ms_static_eid_prefix.description: EID prefix for static registered site in Map Server (MS mode).

ms_static_rloc_address.description: RLOC address (IPv4/IPv6/ELP) for MS static registered site.

ms_static_rloc_priority.description: Priority for the RLOC of the MS static registered site [0-255].

ms_static_rloc_weight.description: Weight for the RLOC of the MS static registered site [0-255].

encapsulation.description: Encapsulation type for data plane: 'LISP' or 'VXLAN-GPE'.

rloc_probe_interval.description: Interval in seconds for periodic RLOC probes.

rloc_probe_retries.description: RLOC probe retries before setting locator down [0..5].

rloc_probe_retries_interval.description: Interval in seconds for RLOC probe retries [1..rloc-probe-interval].

map_resolver_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the Map-Resolver.

static_map_eid_prefix.description: EID prefix for static map cache entry.

static_map_rloc_address.description: RLOC address for static map cache entry.

static_map_rloc_priority.description: Priority for RLOC in static map cache [0-255].

static_map_rloc_weight.description: Weight for RLOC in static map cache [0-255].

rtr_iface_name.description: Interface name for RTR outgoing traffic (RTR mode).

rtr_iface_ip_version.description: IP version for RTR interface: 4 or 6.

map_server_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the Map-Server.

map_server_key.description: Password to authenticate with the Map-Server.

map_server_proxy_reply.description: Configure map-server to Map-Reply on behalf of the xTR: 'on' or 'off'.

proxy_etr_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the Proxy-ETR.

database_eid_prefix.description: EID prefix (ip-prefix/mask) of the mapping for the node.

database_rloc_iface_name.description: Interface name for the node's RLOC interface.

database_rloc_iface_ip_version.description: IP version for the node's RLOC interface: 4 or 6.

database_rloc_iface_priority.description: Priority for the node's RLOC interface [0-255].

database_rloc_iface_weight.description: Weight for the node's RLOC interface [0-255].

elp_name.description: Name to define the ELP used as a reference in the rest of the configuration.

elp_node_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the RLOC for the first ELP node.

elp_node_strict.description: Strict flag for the first ELP node.

elp_node_probe.description: Probe flag for the first ELP node.

elp_node_lookup.description: Lookup flag for the first ELP node.

elp_node_2_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the RLOC for the second ELP node.

elp_node_2_strict.description: Strict flag for the second ELP node.

elp_node_2_probe.description: Probe flag for the second ELP node.

elp_node_2_lookup.description: Lookup flag for the second ELP node.
